newsitem.title: USA: Supreme Court mail order brings out the bomb squad.
newsitem.headline: Supreme Court mail order brings out the bomb squad.

text.p: Some may think wearing sneakers warrants a visit from the fashion police, but it usually doesn't bring out the the FBI -- unless you happen to be Supreme Court Justice Sandra Day O'Connor.
Justice O'Connor arrived home with her usual security contigent at about 4 p.m. on Friday to find a mysterious box with no label and wrapped in black plastic at her front door.

Local authorities were called and told that a suspicious package had been found, and five different organisations responded. While Montgomery County and local Chevy Chase Village police cordoned off the area, explosives experts from the Montgomery fire and rescue unit and Maryland state fire marshall's office began an investigation.

While explosives experts considered bringing in bomb-sniffing dogs or x-raying the package, some basic detective work revealed a more promising lead. "It was turned up that a shoe order had been placed either by the Justice or someone else," Gilman said.
Calls to the sneaker manufacturer and United Parcel Service confirmed that a package matching the black-wrapped box had been delivered to O'Connor's doorstep on Friday.
"We have have had suspicious packages that were explosive devices here, so you take these seriously," fire and rescue spokesman Dan Gilman told Reuters on Saturday.
